name: Stone pillar
description: A square crypt pillar of dark blue-grey dressed stone, 0.7 m square and 3 m high: a stepped moulded base, a shaft of five stacked drums with worn dark joints, and a chamfered capital under a broad square abacus, damp-stained at the foot.
